comments.body: That's what I did. I absolutely hated studying mathematics and computer science. I was bored out of my mind and I had so many nights where I was crying because how much I hated it. I gave up everything for that shit. Nonetheless I forced myself through that crap with top marks. Now I'm preparing to retire by 30 so it was definitely worth the struggle and pain. I basically sold 10 years of my life to live the good life for the rest of my life.
comments.author: Commercial-Claim3290
